THE ORIGIN

Enter after dark.

Black is not absence. It is depth, protection, and elegance with its guard up. The rose survives because it knows its own value—and never asks a shadow for permission to bloom.

The Black Rose name holds one side of the room. Its star-and-rose monument holds the other. Between them: the Bay after dark.
